Create a Quarto report template

create_template.Rd

Copies extension files into _extensions/ and creates a .qmd report file. Optionally opens the created file. If the file already exists, no overwrite occurs and a warning is shown.

Usage

create_template(
  file_name = NULL,
  directory = "reports",
  ext_name = "html",
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  author = NULL,
  affiliation = NULL,
  include_reproducibility = TRUE,
  open_file = TRUE
)

Arguments

file_name

Name of the report file (without .qmd).

directory

Directory to save the report and extensions in.

ext_name

Name of the template extension (e.g. "html", "word").

title

Title of the report.

subtitle

Subtitle of the report.

author

Author name (defaults to Sys.info()[['user']]).

affiliation

Affiliation of the author.

include_reproducibility

Whether or not to include a 'Reproducibility Information' section, which outputs the R session information (default: TRUE).

open_file

Whether to open the file after creation (default: TRUE).

Value

Invisibly returns path to created .qmd file, or NULL if skipped.
